segments.text: Pero hindi man lang pinarusahan ang OSG, yung kanilang personel, na naging dahilan para ma-delay yung pag-file ng motion?

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Kasi, para naman yung mga small fisher folks natin, mapanatang kalooban dahil sabi nila,

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: palibasa malilit kami, wala kaming panlagay, wala kaming pang-PR.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Itong mga malalaking commercial fishing vessels may pang-PR, nanuhul.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Kaya nga, sinadyak ngayon ng OSG na i-delay yung pag-file ng sagot.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: So yun na siguro, para naman ano, kailangan siguro maparusahan o maano man lang,

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: mabigyan ng memo kung sino man yung sa OSG na naging reason para naging delay yung pag-sagot.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Yes, I understand the concern of the good senator.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: In fact, we are hearing this, we are still hearing this in the Committee on Agriculture.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: And the good senator attended, as well as Senator Erwin.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: But my appreciation of the documents when it was presented to me,

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: was that kung merong, of course there is no evidence, we don't have the evidence,

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: but it's speculative, but having said that, just to qualify,

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: parang kung merong nasuhulan, hindi yung soldier,

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Dahil binasa ko yung records, iba yung interpretation ng RTC judge,

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: dun sa interpretation ng soldier, only precisely the technicality of the time within which they could file a motion for...

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Yes, yes. That is my understanding.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: But yun ang immediate reaction ko, bakit ginawa ito ng RTC?

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: But having said that, the soldier is of the view that precisely they did not investigate

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: because the issue for them was a conflict in the interpretation of the law,

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: A probable violation of any individual.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Correct me if I'm wrong, sulod-sulod ang talo ng kaso ng BIFAR sa Supreme Court.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Bakit palaging talunan ang ating mga taga-BIFAR sa mga kaso?

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Pero before going to that, last na naman pala dun sa Mercedar case, anong pinaka-status?

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: It's still with the Supreme Court.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: It's pending ang motion for reconsideration.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: So it's really, right now, the ball is in the court of the Supreme.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: The ball is in the Supreme Court's court.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Sulod-sulod natin ang pagkatalo ng mga kaso ng BIFAR sa pagdating Supreme Court,

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: particularly dun sa paggamit ng vessel monitoring system.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Yes, the Solicitor General's office is likewise unhappy with the ruling of the Supreme Court.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: and therefore, they did file a motion for reconsideration.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: So, last na lamang, anong reason bakit natalo yung before doon sa vessel monitoring system?

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: So, technical ulit dahil hindi nakapag-motion for reconsideration on time?

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: No, this is a ruling on the merits.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: If I recall correctly, very vague, I can recall quite, not exactly the wording,

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: but they were saying that it was a violation of the trade secrets of these commercial fishing vessels.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: So, they did favor the commercial fishing vessels petition.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: And that's why there is now a motion for reconsideration.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Meron motion for reconsideration pending ngayon sa Supreme Court.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: And we are in the Senate.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: At least your Committee on Agriculture, sir, is monitoring this

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: because we are likewise interested in the final outcome

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: because we feel that this is a very important issue.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: And at the moment, Mr. President, if I may add,

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: your Committee on Agriculture likewise would like to inform you

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: that we are revisiting the Fisheries Code

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: The Committee report will be out perhaps after the budget debates

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: so that we can strengthen how we can protect our marginal resources.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Now, let's move on sa Bucor.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Recently, in the past few months,

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: sunod-sunod yung pagpupunta sa akin ng mga PDL na kalalaya lang

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: after 20 years or 30 years nag-serve sa penitentiary.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: And wala man lang binigay sa kanilang pampamasahe.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: They don't know what to do.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Kasi kung ganun ang treatment natin sa mga napalaya natin ng mga PDL

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: eh baka bumalik sila ulit sa masamang gawain

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Wala ba tayong mga halfway houses tulad sa ibang bansa

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: And then, correct me if I'm wrong,

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: dati ata meron tayong tinatawag or sa ibang bansa kuwata na mga ito.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Yung bawat PDL, habang nasa loob sila,

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Doon sa pagtatrabaho nila sa loob,

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: regardless kung anong klaseng trabaho binibigay sa kanila,

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: like one peso or one dollar per day.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: So if you compute that for 20 years na kapag silbi sila,

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: paglabas sila, meron silang 7,000 US dollars or something pesos.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: So hindi sila lumabas ng walang-wala

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: at maghahanap ulit ng diskarte racket para magkaroon ng konting pera.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Kasi maraming beses pupunta, Mr. President, sa akin yung mga PDL.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Tutuwa nga ako sa tiwala nila.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Kaya lang, pupunta sa programo ko sa Wanted sa radyo.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Wala man lang ni Pamasahe na binigay.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Yes, according to the BUCOR, Mr. President,

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: they actually have a budget for transportation and gratuity, number one.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: And number two, there is a program within the facility with the institution

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: wherein when they do manual labor, they are actually given salary

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: and that these are all on record.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: So may nagbubulsa kasi hindi nakakarating sa kanila.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: May nagbubulsa. Sino yung nagbubulsa doon?

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Yes, the good secretary is willing to verify and validate.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Yes, so that this can be checked.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: And so if the information can be relayed to them,

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: And the department secretary says they will not tolerate this malpractice.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: So I'm sure mayroon talaga nagbubulsa dyan na dapat mapunta sa mga PDL,

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: binubulsa, hindi nila naawa, na konsensya na baka yung PDL na yan

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: babalik ulit sa crime dahil kailangan nila magkaroon ng pera.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Matanong ko lang, wala tayong mga safe houses, I mean halfway houses

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Tinitrain sila, yung post-release rehab, mayroon?

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: According to the Bucor, they do have safe houses.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Kapag sila ay na-release na at wala silang uuwi ang mga residente, residential area, may halfway homes.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Wala eh, wala. Wala, wala, wala.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Kasi kung meron, di sinabi na sa akin ng mga PDL na na-release.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Well, according to Bucor, the halfway homes are in Bucor itself.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: So habang hindi sila sinusundo ng kanilang mga kamag-anakan, nandun sila sa Bucor.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: No, dapat yung halfway houses sa labas para reintegrate sila sa society

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: bagay-bagay na kung paano sila makapag-adjust because they've been inside the Muntinlupa for 20, 30 years.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Maninibago sila kung basta-basta muna lang agad isarpak sila sa labas.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Yes. So wala po silang halfway house sa labas.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: So they are asking for the help of the good senator.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Meron pa tayong mga data na yung mga lumaya bumalik ulit dahil napabayaan.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Ang data nila is that recidivists would constitute anywhere between 3 to 5 percent of those being released.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Gusto ko makita yung record na yung mga PDL na 20, 30 years.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Napiit doon sa loob ng Bucor.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: E paglabas nila, dapat meron silang pera na ipon yun through the years ng pagtatrabaho nila.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Is it 1 peso? 2 peso per day?

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: E kaso itong mga PDL pupunta sa akin, walang-wala sir eh.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Eh kung ano lang yung suot nila, yun ang damit nila.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Yung iba daw kasi, ang pat ang kanilang gawain,

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: pag kinita na, pinapadala na sa mga kamag-anakan.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Eh kasi kung ibigay nyo during incarceration,

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Bibilis na sigarilyo, magsugal pa doon.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Ibibigay nyo yun pag na-release na.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Nang sagay yung pag-release nila, meron silang pera.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Their dilemma is that it's the family that is asking for the money.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: kailangan kung ano yung policy natin na ikagaganda, ikabubuti,

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Yun yung sundin natin na paglaya niya, meron siyang pera,

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Yung binibigay nyo yung transportation doon sa PDL,

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: I think this was a couple of weeks ago.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Una sa Muntinupa siya kinasuhan, sa Manila.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: And then na transfer siya sa Iwahig.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: And then binigay siya ng pamasahe, papunta lamang ng Manila.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: In fact, ang tutuloyan niya, bahay niya talaga, is butuan.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: So binigyan ko ng pamasahe, papuntang agusan.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Binigyan ko pa ng konting allowance.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Eh kung hindi natin tulungan yun,

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: eh baka makapag-isipin gumawa ng kalukuan.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: So dapat meron tayong full support sa kanila.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Nang sa ngayon, ma-rehabilitate natin sila post-release.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Para pag i-reintegrate natin sila sa society,

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: They'll be productive members of the society.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: I think we should likewise look into the budget for the transportation.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Kasi kung butuan yun, malaking malaking halaga rin yun.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: And they only have 2.4 million pesos for transportation and gratuity annually.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Kasi kung ganun walang transportation, so anong gagawin ng PDL?

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Para may pamasahe, papunta sa pamilya, sa probigyan.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: And make sure na magawa natin ng remedy yan.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Kung kailan budget, I will support.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Para naman itong mga PDL na napabago na natin sa loob ng bilangguan.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Paglabas, hindi na sila gagawa ng...

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: With the support of the good senator, we will provide the data and the recommendation in terms of an increase.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Couple of questions na lang sa Bucor.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Paano nakakalusot yung drugs at sa mga kontrabando sa loob ng Bucor?

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Akala ko very tight ang security.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Ang kanilang naging karanasan ay right now, nahuhuli na raw bago pa pumasok.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: But ang mga nahuhuli, actually, yung mga kamag-anakan ang nagpapasok sa loob.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: So tinatago sa katawan at nahuhuli naman.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: So yung isang insidente, dalawa ang dinalahan niya ng drugs.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: So nahuli yun dahil magdadala ng drugs doon sa kamag-anakan niyang dalawa.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Mr. President, kasi tuwing gagawa ng Operation Greyhound, which is very good, which is very commendable,

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: pero every time na lang, meron talaga at meron nahuli ng mga kutsilyo, mga kontrabando.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Saan doon nagkukulang ang Bucor security?

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Alam ka ba yung knife ilagay sa private parts ng mga...

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Meron na silang existing machines for screening.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: So minsan kasi nga, pag tinago sa katawan, hindi na lalabas doon sa screening.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Pero yung metal detector, hindi pala, iba pala yun.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Di ba meron na dideliver ata ng mga supplies sa Bucor truck?

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Meron ba kayong x-ray machine for vehicles that enters the Bucor as opposed to aso-aso lang?

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: O baka physical inspection ang ginagawa ng mga tauhan nyo at medyo inaantok-antok pa, kaya nakakalusot?

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Right now, mano-mano pa lang ang kanilang search.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: So a x-ray machine should be...

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Matagal ko na ang ano yun, sinuggested.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Two years ago pa na dapat bumili ng x-ray machine.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Na lahat ng sasakyan na dumadang, maging sasakyan ni boss kung sino yung pinaka-chip,

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: So inuna muna yung screening machine para sa katawan, bago yung x-ray machine.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: So isusunod na yung mga baggage, yung screening machine.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Yes, ang susunod na is for the vehicle.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: So we will include that in the budget.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: And lastly, siguro for now, kung wala pang budget, may pag-coordinate ang Bucor sa TSWD

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: para doon sa mga na-release ng mga PDL.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Kung anong programa meron ng TSWD to help and support them.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Pasok kasi lahat yun sa AICS eh.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: O yun. So meron na silang coordination with the TSWD beginning when?

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Na meron na. Lahat ng nire-release nilang PDL, meron ng AICS na.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: But they are not well informed about that.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Kasi if they know about that, then imbis na pumunta sa programa ko, dumarit siya nang sasana sa TSWD.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: And another thing also, Bucor, get your act together.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Na kapag na-release yung isang PDL, dapat kayo nag-reach out sa mga kamag-anak.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Hinahanapan nyo may kamag-anak ka pa ba?

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Saan ba yung last na alam mo kamag-anak ko sa Butuan po, sa Agusan?

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Tatawagan nyo, tawagin sila chairman para siguraduhin na paglabas niya, meron siya pupuntahan.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: And as opposed to, pabayan natin niya.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Maggulong dyan sa kalsada, papasok ulit sa krimen yun.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Basta pakawalan nyo na lang, bahala ka na.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Dapat meron tatawag mga taga-Bucor, magkipag-connect sa mga kamag-anak para sabihin,

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: o kamag-anak, itong relative nyo, marilis na tomorrow, o salubungin nyo, or diba?

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Or baka meron kayong habilin, meron kayong gustong ipadala na anything.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Pag sinabi mo ginagawa niyan, magagalit ako.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Kasi para doon sa mga matatanda at yung...

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: As in, wala talaga. Okay, sige.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: na sila eh. Kadalas sa kanila,

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: So, yung sa akin ang suggestion,

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: yung mga kamag-anak nila to inform them that

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: itong araw na ito. Kung gusto nyo magsalubong,

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: ng gate, antayin nyo, or mag-ready

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: kayo, bigyan namin yung pamasahe, ito yung

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: salubong nyo sa airport, yung gano'n.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Isa na lang, last na ito.

segments.speaker: Senator Raffy T. Tulfo
segments.text: Correct me if I'm wrong, or something like that.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: So, yung buong AICS program, Mr. President, nakapasok po doon yung burial assistance.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: So, kung magkano po yung hingiing burial assistance ng mga...

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: mga qualified individuals at ma-validate po ng social worker ng DSWD, ay maaaring gamitin po para doon.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Pero, per individual na hihingi at makakatanggap ng funeral assistance, yung cost ng assistance na iyon ay mula isang libo hanggang 50,000 pesos po.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Halimbawa lang po, lumagpas ng 50,000, sagot na po ng tao yun.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Unfortunately, Mr. President, kung lalampas man ang kinakailangang funeral assistance sa 50,000 pesos, sa ngayon po, sa AICS, hanggang doon lamang po.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Dahil noong panahong tinakda po ng department yung range ng assistance para sa funeral assistance, at that time, at least po, pasok po sa 50,000 pesos, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Halimbawa po, katulad po sa Baguio, nung nagkaroon po ng landslide, medyo marami pong namatay doon.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Paano po yun kung lagpas sa 50,000 po yung kanilang funeral services?

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Mr. President, actually, nung nangyari po yung lindol na iyon ay naalala po yan ni Secretary dahil pumunta sila po doon.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: At least doon sa karanasan ng department, sa disaster na iyon.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Sa funeral assistance na nai-extend po nila noon, nagka siya po sa 50,000.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: At in that instance po, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Okay po. Halimbawa po, kulang yung 50,000. Hindi po ba yung gagawin ng paraan ng DSWD kapag gaganon pong merong kahindik-hindik na pangyayari?

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Actually po, yung tanong niyo, Mr. President, ay tumpak doon sa kayang gawin ng social work.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Yung worker ng DSWD. Doon sa social intake, pag sa tansya po niya, hindi talaga kakasya ang kinakailangang funeral assistance ng isang individual in crisis.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Hindi kakasya sa 50,000. Kaya pala po niyang i-override yung 50,000 pesos upper limit at dagdagan po, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: So napakagandang balita po niyan dahil sa dami po ng kalamidad natin dito sa bayan natin, pagkasana po sa mga kasong...

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Alam niyo naman po, kapag ka-biktima ka ng kalamidad, lahat na kabuhayan mo, kaari-arian mo, apiktado.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Yung pong, yung pong, halimbawa po, yung mga puninarya at yung mga hospital po, yung mga tinatawag po nating service providers.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: O po, yung po ba nababayaran natin yun sa tamang oras po?

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Ayon po sa department, Mr. President, basta't napapadala ng ospital ang bill on time at kumpleto po yung support yung documents,

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: o po, nababayaran nila ng department in time.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Yung exception po ay yung problematic situation noong 2024 na pinag-usapan kanina kasama ni Sen. Lacasaw, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: O po, o po. Bali ngayon po, wala na pong suliranin doon. Talagang nababayaran na po kaagad.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Sa ngayon, o po, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: O po, sa buong Pilipinas po yun.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Meron po kasi kami dito pagdating doon.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Yes, well, salamat po, Mr. President, kung i-enlighten niyo po kami sa mga sitwasyon na hindi.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Pero to the best of his knowledge, ngayong gabi, Mr. President, ng Secretary, oo.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: But kung may mga sitwasyon na hindi pala yun ang nangyayari, the department is very willing to hear about it from the good gentleman

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: para kanila pong matugunan at maiwas to, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: O po, kasi ang DSWD po.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Yung madalas naming lapitan na humihingi po kami ng guarantee letters.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Tungkol naman po doon sa binawasan ang budget ng AICS, di ba po malungkot ito?

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Sabi po ng department, dahil sa kanilang pananaw, ang programang AICS sa ngayon ay tumutugon sa mga service gaps, malungkot nga daw po.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Of course, may ibang wisdom pa.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: At kaya po, bagamat sa committee report natin, nadagdagan yung NEP, pero mas mababa po siya sa gab, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Napaka-shape din naman ang answer na.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Pero bukas pong representasyong itong, ano, duminig at tumugon sa mga follow-up questions, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Ito yung interest of pag-improve po ng budget.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Ano po kaya, aming ginang sponsor, wala po bang maapektuhan doon?

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Ayon sa department, Mr. President, of course, opo, may maapektuhan.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Hindi po ba yung pwedeng mapakibusapan?

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Pero in fairness din po sa Senate, binigay naman po natin ang request nila sa NEP. At tinigitan pa, di ba?

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Dahil po sa NEP, Mr. President, maalala natin, ang value po doon ay P33,292,000,000.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Plus, sa committee report natin po sa Senado, Mr. President,

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: So hindi po totoo itong, itong chismis na ito na binaba? Hindi po totoo?

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Binaba po mula sa House version, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Tapos dito po sa atin, tinaas na.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Binaba from the House version po. Mas mataas lamang po siya sa NEP.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Pero mas mababa po kaysa sa NEP.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Sa mas maintindihan po ng ating taong bayan,

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Overall, kumpara sa last year, mas mababa po siya, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Dahil yung gaaw po ay P63,000,000,000.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Ano po ang solusyon natin doon sa maapektuhan po? Ano po ang maaring maging solusyon?

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Para pong nagkakaroon kami ng dialogue dito ni Secretary, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Pero sa totoo, dumudulog po sila sa atin.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Dito sa Senado na itaas po ulit yung value po.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Hindi po pwede pakiusapan si SP?

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Binabasa po ng good gentleman ang isip ng sponsor na in the spirit of brotherly love daw.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Pero sa buong institusyon ay magkaroon daw ng dialogue.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Insya Allah, insya Allah. Magkaroon po ng pagbabago hanggat hindi pa pinal.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Dahil naniniwala po tayo sa mga programa ng DSWD.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Nakakarating po sa ground. Nakakarating doon sa matatawag po nating nasa pinakamababang sitwasyon.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Ako po kasi ay merong panukala patungkol sa mga senior citizen.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Kasi ang nanay ko po ay 92 years old na.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Ilang beses kami bumalik sa ospital.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Ngayon binigyan pa kami ng doktor ng order na tatlong caregiver. May nurse pa.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: So, ako po ay nagdudugo ang puso ko kapag dumadaan po ko sa kalsada na hindi na po mga pulubing bata ang nakikita ko.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Kung di mga senior citizen na po. Lolo, lola.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Ang programa natin sa DSWD para sa mga senior citizen.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Ano po ba ang drama natin sa DSWD para sa mga senior citizen?

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Mr. President, ang department po ay mayroong pong apat na dedicated na senior shelters all over the country.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Kapag po may nadatnaan or may iulat sa department na, kunyari, homeless na senior citizen,

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: nire-rescue po nila sila mula sa lansangan at dinadala po sa mga shelter na ito, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Sino po ang kapartner po ng DSWD sa pag-rescue?

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Mr. President, at least po sa mga metropolitan areas sa Manila at saka po sa Cebu,

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: kahit nga po devolved na yung social welfare function ng governance,

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: inako pa rin po ng DSWD yung tungkulin na i-rescue ang isang,

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: ang mga senior citizen mula sa lansangan at dalhin sila sa shelter.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Kahit po actually LGU function po ito, pero inangkin na rin po nila, inako po nila yung tungkulin.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: At ito po yung, ito pong apat na dedicated na senior shelters all over the country,

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: sa ilalim po ng tinatawag na pag-abot program ng DSWD.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Rescue, pagdala sa shelter, and then paghatid sa kanila ulit sa kanilang tahanan, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Saan po yung kalagayan ng pasilidad po? Saan po itong pasilidad?

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Mr. President, kaya po humihingi ng dagdag na pondo ang department para sa care facilities

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Medyo luma na po itong apat na senior shelters at sila po yung nakalocate sa NCR at Regions 4, 8, 9, at 11.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Nakita recently ni Secretary yung dalawa sa apat na ito at talaga pong bagamat maayos,

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: pero kailangan pong i-upgrade, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Kamusta po yung populasyon niya sa ngayon?

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Ito po ba ay punong-puno o kailangan ng palakihin?

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Mr. President, magsu-submit po ang DSWD ng breakdown ng occupancy ng apat na residences. Pero sa apat na residential care facilities for older persons, 687 total.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: 309 ay mga lalaki at 378 ay mga babae. Full occupancy na po ang apat na ito. Kaya kapag overcapacity na ay i-farm out ang ilang residente sa private care facilities at babayaran ng department ang cost ng pagtira nila doon, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Yung mga private, parang nursing homes po iyan, ano?

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Parang shelters or nursing homes, Mr. President?

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Yun naman po ay pasado sa DSWD.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Pasado po, Mr. President, dahil sa mga accredited private care facilities lamang

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: i-rehome ng department yung mga senior residents nila?

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Kasi po, papunta dito sa Senado, galing ng Fairview, galing sa bahay namin,

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Nadadaanan ko po yung mga lola at lolo dito sa Maynila.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Ito po yung nakikiraan naman po ko sa idol natin na si Mayor Isko.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Magaling po yan si Mayor Isko.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Pero diyan po sa papuntang Ruas Boulevard, pagkaliwa mo,

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Araw-araw po yan na nandun yung baka po pwedeng magawan po ninyo ng paraan

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: na kawawa naman po yung mga lolo at lola doon

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: na kahit umuulan, namamalimos, nagbebenta ng sampagita.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Kahit po sa Quezon Boulevard, nakahilera po sila doon.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Temporarily, tumira muna sa shelter. Pero pag susumikapan talaga nilang i-reintegrate sila sa kanilang mga pamilya.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: And kaugnay din po ito, Mr. President, kalakhan po kasi ng mga cases ng mga seniors in street situation ay naliligaw.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Yung iba sa kanila may demensya at LGU po ay inihahatid nila sa kanilang pamilya para nga po dun sa family reunification.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: At kaya rin po siguro yung kanina nabanggit ko po yung population ng older person sa mga DSWD care facilities ay nasa hundreds lamang po, 687 total.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Kaya po yung demand for elderly residences ay mababa at need pong i-upgrade itong mga residences na ito.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Siguro may preference pa rin for family reunification where possible and doable po, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Namin ginang sponsor sa nakakausap po namin kasi marami po sa mga matatanda ay hindi na tinatanggap sa kanilang pamilya dahil yun nga po parang mabigat na at yung iba naman po kailangan magtrabaho.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Yung mga anak nila, ano nila, naiiwan na po yung...

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Sa akin po, ano po talaga ito.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Sunod ko na lang pong tanong, paano po yung trabaho?

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Pero Mr. President, bago po magpatuloy ang Good Gentleman, nakikiisa po kaming lahat dito, itong representasyon, ang department, sa habag nararamdaman ng Good Gentleman.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: At sabi nga po ni Secretary habang sinasalay sa inyo po ito, sa mga malulungkot na sitwasyon na hindi na po nakakayaman,

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: o nagiging sustainable yung family reunification para sa mga elderly in street situations, kukukupin po talaga ng department.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Dahil ang bawat matanda po dapat ay may tahanan, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Yung po bang NCSC, yung National Commission of Senior Citizens, ano po ang kanilang nagagawa patungkol dito?

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Marami-rami po at varied ang partnerships po ng National Commission on Senior Citizens.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Hindi lang po sa ibang mga government agencies, pati po sa private sector.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Halimbawa po sa Integrated Bar of the Philippines.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Tapos sa mga government agencies sa CICC.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Halimbawa para labanan yung mga scams na bumibiktima sa mga senior citizens.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: May partnership din po sila sa Department of Agriculture.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Para maging senior citizen friendly din po yung mga infrastruktura sa ating mga syudad

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: at yung mga gusali din po na pinapasukan, ginagamit din ng ating mga senior citizens.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: So marami-rami po yung mga partnerships and ongoing programs nila sa mga government

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: at sa private sector organizations, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Meron pong pagkakataon po ba na nakaikot din po ba sila sa mga private nursing homes

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: at sinek po nila yung kalagayan ng mga senior doon?

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Yung mga hindi po maayos na residence facilities ay mga hindi accredited ng DSWD.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Na ang department po kasi ang may jurisdiction po sa kanila.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Hindi po ang roles with the National Commission on Senior Citizens.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: So accredited lamang po yung mga private centers for older persons na iniikutan po ng DSWD para i-monitor.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: At ang kabuang bilang po ng mga ito, accredited private centers for older persons,

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: ay labin lima sa buong bansa natin, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Pwede po bang humiling sa grupo ng NCS?

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Meron pong kasabihan tayong walking the extra mile.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Kasi kung lagi po tayong nandun lang sa mandato,

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: sayang po ang pagiging public servant natin.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Sana kung meron po silang extra time sa makita din po nila yung mga nursing homes.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Kung ano pong sitwasyon, umikot din po sila.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Kasi hindi po trabaho ng opisina namin maghanap.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: At isa din po dyan, yung patungkol sa mga PDL.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Yung mga nakakulong po ng mga matatanda din.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Sana meron din po kayong pagkakataon na mabisita po ninyo.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Kasi hindi naman po namin trabaho.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Nagiging trabaho po ng opisina namin.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Kasi nanginiwala kami sa walk the extra mile.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Yung pong isang nakakulong sa Pasig na pinuntahan ng opisina namin.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Ang tagal na po pala dun.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Yung meron lang pong mag-middleman ba.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Kung hindi nyo po trabaho yan.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Idagdag na lang po nyo sa ating public service.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Willing naman po yung National Commission on Senior Citizens to walk that extra mile.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Karamihan policy yung ginaganap nilang trabaho.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Pero sila na rin po ang may jurisdiction dun sa pagpatupad ng Centenarian Act.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: At the same time, meron po silang mga commissioners na naka-assign din naman po para sa iba't ibang mga regyon.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Tatanungin ko rin po ngayon kung ano po yung inputs nila tungkol dun sa senior persons with disability.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: I'm sorry, what did I say?

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Senior persons deprived of liberty, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Mr. President, nabanggit ko na rin po kanina na yung isa sa mga private sector organizations

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: na may tie-up ang National Commission.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Yung senior citizens ay yung Integrated Bar of the Philippines.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Dahil sa partnership pong iyon, laan po sila na asistihan yung mga senior persons deprived of liberty sa kanilang mga kaso po, Mr. President?

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: May isang kahilingan na lang po ako.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Pwede po bang magsagawa ang DSWD ng isang proposal ng isang...

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Baka po sakaling isang araw mapondohan natin.

segments.speaker: Senator Robinhood C. Padilla
segments.text: Ang nursing home at magbigay po kayo ng proposal sa opisina ko at sakali pong ito ay maisusog po natin.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Speaking of walking the extra mile, Mr. President, magwo one step further ang DSWD,

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: makakapagpadala po sila sa opisina ninyo, design pati costing ng isang hindi lang single residence,

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
